heading: Today
text: Mostly cloudy, a few sprinkles or drizzle over the higher terrain, a few breaks of sun in southern valleys.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Mostly cloudy, some clearing south late. Cooler.

heading: Thursday
text: Some morning clouds north, then increasing sunshine.
temperature: Upper 40s to mid 50s north, mid 50s to around 60 south

heading: Friday
text: Rain and showers spreading west to east.
temperature: 50s to near 60 west and south of I-89, upper 40s to lower 50s northeast
